ar.why: #49 — one word for the unit of the product. The catalogue says لقاء 106 times; جلسة عمل is the older term and reads as a corporate working session rather than a coffee between founders.

allow.host_page_title: #49 open — still استضف جلسة عمل. Delete this line with the rename.

ar.why: #66 — the footer link and the page it opens must name the same thing. Settled the other way round from how this entry first read: the destination is نشاطي, and the footer, the profile section nav and the page heading now all say it. The earlier direction would have renamed the one footer key to match the four page keys, on the grounds that four beat one; the count was the weaker argument. نشاطي names a place the reader owns, and it is the label they click. The possessive form is what is banned here, not the word: the tabs still say لقاءات انضممت إليها, and لقاء remains the canonical word for the unit of the product one entry above. The page's prose stays in the second person — a page called نشاطي still says ما انضممت إليه وما استضفته, the same way My Account talks about your data.

#56 — the status and its undo should share a root. إلغاء الحضور is the undo, so the status it undoes is about حضور, not about قادم. Note the bare form only: القادمة and قادمًا mean upcoming and are a different word in use.

allow.activity_joined_empty: #56 — reads لا لقاء قادم, 'no upcoming meetup'. This is the upcoming sense, not the RSVP status. Keep.
allow.feedback_next_event: #56 — اللقاء القادم, 'the next meetup'. Upcoming sense. Keep.
allow.activity_upcoming: #56 — the Upcoming tab label. Genuine upcoming sense, and the reason the rename matters: today قادم is both this tab and the RSVP status two screens away. Renaming the status leaves this one unambiguous. Keep.

ar.decide: #56 settled the noun/imperative half: مشاركة is the dialog heading (share_event) and شارك is the button (share_event_action). What is left is footer_participate, which still uses شارك for Participate — a different meaning on a surface the reader moves between. Give that one its own word, انضم or احضر, and this entry can gain a canonical and start being enforced.
ar.why: #56 — one word, two meanings, on surfaces a reader moves between.
